# KM-173 — Agent `khala_event` tool and `sendChannelEvent` client method

**Lane:** events · **Complexity:** 2 · **Model:** codex · **Depends on:** KM-143, KM-144, KM-170, KM-171 · **Serializes with:** none
**Plan context (pinned):** [M1 plan](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/plans/2026-10-01-002-refactor-external-m1-thin-path-plan.md) · [contracts](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/contracts.md) · [roster and graph](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/roster.md) · [events plan](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/plans/2026-10-01-003-feat-channel-events-plan.md)
**Exclusive write surfaces:** `packages/agent/src/events/emit.ts`, `packages/agent/src/events/emit.test.ts`. Shared (listed edits only): `packages/agent/src/matrix/session.ts` (KM-110), `packages/agent/src/client.ts` (KM-103), `packages/agent/src/client-impl.ts` (KM-143), `packages/agent/src/mcp/tools.ts` and `tools.test.ts` (KM-144), `packages/agent/src/matrix/session.test.ts` (KM-110; its `not_implemented` case only). Not `SKILL.md`: that is KM-146's surface and there is no edge between the two tickets; the `khala_event` tool description carries the guidance instead.

## Outcome

An agent posts a channel event in one MCP call: `khala_event` with Khala-native JSON or a raw Aiur event. The tool validates (KM-170) or maps (KM-171), then the agent client sends one encrypted `com.khala.event.v1` timeline event whose Matrix transaction id is derived from `key`, so a retry in the same process is idempotent at the homeserver.

## Context and evidence

- Events plan unit **E-U4** (R1, R8, R9; AE1, AE2), KTD4, KTD5.
- **Path reconciliation.** The plan's provisional `packages/agent/src/tools/event.ts` and `packages/agent/src/cli/event.ts` are re-pointed to the M1 layout: tools live in `packages/agent/src/mcp/tools.ts` (contracts C7), so this ticket adds one tool entry there and keeps its logic in `packages/agent/src/events/emit.ts`.
- **There is no `khala event` CLI (Executor decision, reconciliation A6; contracts C7).** A separate process cannot hold the agent's in-memory crypto device: M1 KTD1 makes the device an in-memory rust-crypto store whose "device lifetime equals process lifetime", C4 gives each process its own device, and C5 deletes `session.json` on exit. M1 KTD7 also says: "There are no CLI subcommands beyond `khala mcp` and `khala hook <name>`." Only the `khala_event` MCP tool exists.
- **Client and session methods (already in contracts C7 and C11).** KM-143 owns the base client; this ticket adds `sendChannelEvent` to `KhalaAgentClient` and its implementation, implements C11's `AgentMatrixSession.sendChannelEvent` (KM-110 may have stubbed it to throw `not_implemented`), and adds the `khala_event` tool, raising KM-144's tool-count assertion from 4 to 5.
- **Error codes.** `invalid_event` is a tool-level result produced by `resolveEventInput` before the client is called; it is not a `KhalaErrorCode`. Client-side failures use only the C7 `KhalaErrorCode` values.

## Scope

- `sendChannelEvent` on `KhalaAgentClient` and in `client-impl.ts`.
- `khala_event` MCP tool and its input handling in `events/emit.ts`.
- No skill-text change (KM-146 owns `SKILL.md`; the tool description is enough).

## Non-goals

- The base client, session and send path: **KM-143** (reuse, do not restructure).
- MCP server scaffolding and the four C7 tools: **KM-144**.
- Receiving or displaying events for agents: **KM-174**. Browser pill: **KM-172**.
- The `khala event` CLI and any outbox: dropped by the Executor (A6); never build it.
- Aiur adapter docs: **KM-175**.

## Contract and invariants

contracts.md C7, verbatim (the parts this ticket implements):

> | `khala_send` | `{ text: string (1..8000) }` | `{ eventId }`. Errors: `not_connected`, `send_failed` |
> | `khala_event` | `{ event?: object, aiur?: object, ticketPrefix?: string (0..16) }`, exactly one of `event` / `aiur` | `{ eventId }` or `{ skipped: true }`. Errors: `invalid_event` (with `path`, `code`), `not_connected`, `send_failed` |
>
> - `tools/list` returns exactly these 5 tools in this order. KM-144 ships the first four and asserts 4; KM-173 adds `khala_event` and updates that assertion to 5.
> - There is **no `khala event` CLI**: a separate process cannot hold the agent's in-memory crypto device. Only the `khala_event` MCP tool exists.
>
> ```ts
> // packages/agent/src/client.ts
> export interface KhalaAgentClient {
>   join(link: string, label: string): Promise<{ state: 'awaiting_confirmation'; confirmUrl: string } | { state: 'connected'; channelName: string }>;
>   status(): Promise<{ state: string; channelName?: string; agentUserId?: string; unread: number }>;
>   read(limit: number, before?: string): Promise<{ messages: InboxEntry[]; nextBefore?: string }>;
>   send(text: string): Promise<{ eventId: string }>;
>   sendChannelEvent(content: ChannelEventContent): Promise<{ eventId: string }>;   // added by KM-173 (absent before it); errors as send()
>   close(): Promise<void>;
> }
>
> export type KhalaErrorCode = 'invalid_link' | 'link_unavailable' | 'join_expired' | 'not_connected' | 'send_failed' | 'session_unknown' | 'internal_error';
> export class KhalaClientError extends Error { readonly code: KhalaErrorCode; constructor(code: KhalaErrorCode, message?: string) }   // KM-103 ships it
> ```

contracts.md C11, verbatim (the session surface; this ticket implements `sendChannelEvent` and uses nothing else new):

```ts
// packages/agent/src/matrix/session.ts
export type SessionMessage = { eventId: string; roomId: string; sender: string; ts: number; type: 'm.room.message' | 'com.khala.event.v1'; body: string; content: Record<string, unknown> };
export interface AgentMatrixSession {
  readonly userId: string;
  onMessage(handler: (m: SessionMessage) => void): () => void;      // excludes own sender; includes com.khala.event.v1
  waitForInvite(roomId: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<void>;   // resolves once the invite is seen in /sync
  join(roomId: string): Promise<void>;                               // joinRoom, accepting the MSC4268 bundle
  history(roomId: string, limit: number, before?: string): Promise<{ messages: SessionMessage[]; nextBefore?: string }>;
  send(roomId: string, text: string): Promise<{ eventId: string }>;
  sendChannelEvent(roomId: string, content: Record<string, unknown>, txnId?: string): Promise<{ eventId: string }>;
  roomName(roomId: string): string | undefined;
  displayName(userId: string): string | undefined;                  // from room member state; Round 2 R4
  stop(): Promise<void>;
}
export function createAgentMatrixSession(creds: AgentCredentials, opts?: { log?: (line: string) => void }): Promise<AgentMatrixSession>;
```

> - `sendChannelEvent` may be stubbed to throw `not_implemented` in KM-110; KM-173 implements it.

contracts.md C9, verbatim: "Defined by `docs/plans/2026-10-01-003-feat-channel-events-plan.md`, with Matrix type `com.khala.event.v1`. Its contract file is `packages/contracts/src/m1/channel-event.ts`."

Invariants: the Matrix type is always `CHANNEL_EVENT_TYPE`; content is always the value returned by `encodeChannelEvent`/`mapAiurEvent` (never the raw input); `txnId = 'khev-' + sha256hex(content.key).slice(0, 32)` when `key` is set, else the SDK default; a `null` mapping is `{ skipped: true }`, not an error.

## Implementation pointers (refreshable)

### Files

- Create `packages/agent/src/events/emit.ts`, `packages/agent/src/events/emit.test.ts`.
- Modify `packages/agent/src/matrix/session.ts` (+ its unit test), `packages/agent/src/client.ts`, `packages/agent/src/client-impl.ts` (+ test), `packages/agent/src/mcp/tools.ts`, `packages/agent/src/mcp/tools.test.ts` (and the KM-144 fake client inside it), and KM-110's `session.test.ts` scenario 9a, which asserted the `not_implemented` stub: replace it with "`sendChannelEvent` calls `client.sendEvent(roomId, 'com.khala.event.v1', content, txnId)` and returns `{ eventId }`".

### Worked example

Tool call: `khala_event { "aiur": <KM-171 fixture pr-ready-for-review.json>, "ticketPrefix": "AIUR-" }`
→ `mapAiurEvent(aiur, { ticketLabel: id => 'AIUR-' + id })` → content (KM-171 worked example, `key: "pr:aiur-team/aiur:ready_for_review:412:3f9c2ab0d1"`)
→ `client.sendChannelEvent(content)` → Matrix `sendEvent(roomId, 'com.khala.event.v1', content, 'khev-<32 hex of sha256(key)>')`
→ tool result `{ "eventId": "$abc" }`, text `Posted channel event: AIUR-395 review requested · feat/events-cursor`.

Tool call: `khala_event { "event": { "kind": "ci.failed", "summary": "CI failed: test", "subject": { "ticket": "AIUR-395", "branch": "aiur/395-events-cursor" } } }` → sends; the AE3 line is `AIUR-395 CI failed: test · aiur/395-events-cursor`.

### Steps

0. `matrix/session.ts`: replace KM-110's `sendChannelEvent` stub (C11 signature, unchanged: `sendChannelEvent(roomId: string, content: Record<string, unknown>, txnId?: string): Promise<{ eventId: string }>`) with the real implementation beside `send`: `client.sendEvent(roomId, CHANNEL_EVENT_TYPE as never, content as never, txnId)` → `{ eventId: res.event_id }`. Only this file touches matrix-js-sdk (KM-143 rule: client-impl never reaches into the SDK).
1. `client.ts`: add `sendChannelEvent(content: ChannelEventContent): Promise<{ eventId: string }>;` to `KhalaAgentClient` (type import from `@khala/contracts/m1/channel-event`).
2. `client-impl.ts`: implement it next to `send(text)`. Use the same connected-session check (`not_connected`), the same session object and room id, and the same failure handling (`status.json` → `send_failed`, typed error). Call `session.sendChannelEvent(roomId, content, txnId)` with `txnId` from `node:crypto` `createHash('sha256')`. Re-check `encodeChannelEvent(content).ok` first and, if not ok, throw `new KhalaClientError('internal_error', 'invalid_event')` (defence in depth; `invalid_event` is not a `KhalaErrorCode`).
3. `events/emit.ts`: export `resolveEventInput(args: unknown): { kind: 'send'; content: ChannelEventContent } | { kind: 'skipped' } | { kind: 'invalid'; path: string; code: string }`. Rules: both or neither of `event`/`aiur` → invalid `{path: '', code: 'invalid_value'}`; `event` → `encodeChannelEvent`; `aiur` → `mapAiurEvent(aiur, ticketPrefix ? { ticketLabel: id => ticketPrefix + id } : {})` (never pass `ticketLabel: undefined`; `exactOptionalPropertyTypes` is on in `tsconfig.base.json:9`), `null` → skipped. Argument validation: only the keys `event`, `aiur`, `ticketPrefix`; `event`/`aiur` must be plain objects; `ticketPrefix` a string of 0..16 characters; anything else → invalid `{path: <key>, code: 'invalid_value'}`.
4. `mcp/tools.ts`: register `khala_event` with a JSON input schema matching the table and this description, verbatim: `Post a compact progress event (PR, CI, ticket status) into the Khala channel. Events are progress signals, not chat messages: they never wake other agents. Pass Khala JSON as "event", or a raw Aiur bus event, wake record or alert as "aiur".` Handler: `resolveEventInput` → `client.sendChannelEvent` → result as in the table.
5. Update KM-144's I1 assertion (scenario 1 in `packages/agent/src/mcp/tools.test.ts`) to exactly `['khala_join','khala_status','khala_read','khala_send','khala_event']`; extend the fake client there with `sendChannelEvent` that records calls.

## Test scenarios

File: `packages/agent/src/events/emit.test.ts` and the KM-144 tools test.

1. Valid `event` → fake `sendChannelEvent` called once with `type`-ready content (`v: 1`, `body` filled); result `{ eventId }`. (Covers R1, R9)
2. `event` with `url: "javascript:alert(1)"` → `invalid_event` with `path: 'url'`; no send. (Covers AE5)
3. `aiur` = KM-171 `system-branch-push.json` → `{ skipped: true }`; no send.
4. `aiur` = AE1 fixture + `ticketPrefix: 'AIUR-'` → sent content line `AIUR-395 review requested · feat/events-cursor`. (Covers AE1)
5. Both `event` and `aiur` → `invalid_event`.
6. `client-impl` unit (fake session): same content sent twice → identical `txnId`; different `key` → different `txnId`; no `key` → `txnId` undefined. (Covers AE2, R8)
7. Not connected → `not_connected`; session `sendChannelEvent` rejects → `send_failed` and `status.json` state `send_failed`.
8. `tools/list` returns exactly 5 tools including `khala_event` with its schema.

Root typecheck failures elsewhere are recorded, not fixed (KTD11).

## Risks and stop conditions

- **Shared file with KM-174.** KM-174 also edits `client-impl.ts` (and its test) and may edit `matrix/session.ts`; the roster has no edge between the two (requested: `serializes_with` KM-173 ~ KM-174). Rebase on whichever merged first; if the conflict touches behaviour rather than lines, stop and ask.
- `client-impl.ts` has no single send path to reuse: stop and ask. Never create a second Matrix client.
- The merged `session.ts` does not match C11 (other names, or `sendChannelEvent` missing entirely rather than stubbed): stop; that is a KM-110 contract defect.
- Anyone asks for a `khala event` CLI: decline; A6 dropped it (it would need an outbox in C5 and a KTD7 exception).
- matrix-js-sdk 42.4.0 refuses a custom type in `sendEvent` typing: cast the type argument only; never send as `m.room.message`.

## Complexity rationale

One client method mirroring `send`, one tool entry and a small input resolver. Removing the CLI keeps it at 2.
